controls.name: Explicit regional trust registration
controls.requirement: Every deployment region has an organization-scoped trust-domain record.

controls.name: Pinned peer bundles
controls.requirement: Peer SPIFFE bundles are public-only and SHA-256 digest pinned before activation.

controls.name: Trust continuity snapshots
controls.requirement: Active anchors, workload policies and HSM public metadata are captured into sealed snapshots.

controls.name: Human-governed restore
controls.requirement: Disaster-recovery trust restore requires integrity verification and explicit operator approval.

controls.name: Transparency chain
controls.requirement: Release and trust-continuity events are appended to an organization-scoped hash chain.
